mapper.select: SELECT SQL_SEQ, PGM_NM, SQL_NM, SQL_STMT, SQL_FROM_STMT, SQL_ORDER_BY_ID, SQL_DESC, SQL_STAT, RGST_DTIME, UPDT_DTIME, UPDT_USER, USE_YN, IS_SPECIAL FROM SYS_SQL_MASTER WHERE SQL_SEQ = #{sqlSeq, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(TO_NUMBER(SQL_SEQ)) IS NULL OR MAX(TO_NUMBER(SQL_SEQ)) = '' THEN 1 ELSE MAX(TO_NUMBER(SQL_SEQ)) + 1 END FROM SYS_SQL_MASTER
